definitions.gloss: to hit on; to pick up; to flirt with strangers
definitions.explanation: The act of approaching strangers (typically women) in public places to try to get their attention romantically.

definitions.gloss: a person who hits on others; a flirt
definitions.explanation: Someone who frequently tries to pick up strangers.

examples.english: I can't trust guys who are always hitting on people.

notes:
ナンパ refers to the act of approaching strangers in public places (streets, bars, etc.) to try to start a romantic or sexual interaction. Also describes a person who frequently does this.

ETYMOLOGY:
From {軟派|なんぱ}, originally meaning a "soft faction" in politics, later applied to frivolous or romantic pursuits.

REGISTER:
Casual/colloquial. Often carries negative connotations — being called ナンパ{師|し} is not a compliment. The passive form ナンパされる is very common in conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ナンパする: to hit on someone
- ナンパされる: to get hit on
- ナンパ{師|し}: pickup artist
- {逆|ぎゃく}ナン: when women approach men (reverse nanpa)
- ナンパな{男|おとこ}: a flirtatious/frivolous guy
